_comment: Seed data only, not an enforced CI gate yet -- see bench/RESULTS.md for caveats and methodology. Captured by actually running chronicle-bench, not projected.
known_issues: single-threaded tracked_assignment is ~10ns/op SLOWER than the old mutex-based implementation -- the thread_local lookup in ring_for_current_thread() has real cost; see bench/RESULTS.md's Interpretation section. The design's actual win is in the contended_record_* numbers, not the single-threaded ones.
contended_record_1_thread includes a concurrently-running drainer thread and is not directly comparable to the single-threaded numbers above
history_query results at small sizes (10, 1000 events) were noisy in prior measurement and are omitted here pending a better methodology; do not gate CI on them
